titulo: A spare key on the hook, with a friend's initial
caption:
A spare key on the hook, with a friend's initial

One spare key goes up on the hook, and its tag has someone else's initial on it.

For whoever keeps a spare key for someone.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A coral room. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left and a navy one stands on the right looking away. A small gold key lies on the floor between them. It floats up onto a short wooden shelf with a hook and hangs there, and a small white tag with the letter D pops up beside it. The navy figure turns, its eyes go wide and then close in a smile and it pulses. The black one smiles too. The text stays: 1 spare key, with a friend's initial. The last card: for whoever keeps a spare key for someone, Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: Cella hung a spare key today. Somebody's initial is on the tag.
evolucion: Dos apuestas (junta-dic-s4, seccion 3). (a) El cierre con persona, sin pedido: ninguna pieza pide guardar, comentar, compartir, enviar ni seguir (regla 8); el fijado es una frase de Cella que nombra al destinatario. Base de lectura: N2 16 % (14 de 88 Reels), 1,5 envios por 1.000 de alcance, mediana de alcance 117; con el mismo corte de la hora 168 (3-ene). (b) El destinatario como gancho: brazo A (abre con "For whoever ..." en el cuadro 0 y vuelve a cerrar) contra brazo B (solo cierra). Se mide a 48 h con medir.py (envios por 1.000 de alcance, vistas comprometidas) y a 7 dias con objetivos.py (N2, N4). Con 14 seguidores y la semana de fiestas no separa causa de temporada: lectura de orden de magnitud.
